segments.name: Franchised Dealerships Segment
products: new and used cars and light trucks
segments.description: Operates franchised dealerships selling new and used cars and light trucks, providing parts, service and collision repair and arranging financing and insurance.
segments.evidence: The Franchised Dealerships Segment provides comprehensive sales and services, including: (1) sales of both new and used cars and light trucks

segments.name: EchoPark Segment
segments.description: Sells used cars and light trucks and arranges third-party finance and insurance products in pre-owned vehicle specialty retail locations.
segments.evidence: The EchoPark Segment sells used cars and light trucks and arranges third-party F&I product sales for our guests in pre-owned vehicle specialty retail locations

segments.name: Powersports Segment
segments.description: Sells new and used powersports vehicles such as motorcycles, watercraft and all-terrain vehicles, with parts, service and finance and insurance.
segments.evidence: The Powersports Segment offers guests: (1) sales of both new and used powersports vehicles (such as motorcycles, personal watercraft and all-terrain vehicles)

revenueModel.text: Vehicle buyers pay Sonic Automotive for new and used vehicles, parts, service and repair, financing and insurance products.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our revenue is related to our Franchised Dealerships Segment.
